items.title: Killian Hayes and Barcelona have agreed to a deal, including an NBA opt out clause, agent Yann Balikouzou of LIFT Sports Management told HoopsHype. The 7th pick of the 2020 draft averaged 7.9 points, 5.0 assists, and 1.1 steals in six NBA seasons with the Pistons, Nets, and Kings
items.author: Michael Scotto
items.body_excerpt: Killian Hayes and Barcelona have agreed to a deal, including an NBA opt out clause, agent Yann Balikouzou of LIFT Sports Management told HoopsHype. The 7th pick of the 2020 draft averaged 7.9 points, 5.0 assists, and 1.1 steals in six NBA seasons with the Pistons, Nets, and Kings.
